groupRule: special-review means at least one skinned mesh, postprocessing component, collision module or external force module; remaining models are shared-advanced. This is implementation triage, not a guarantee of individual code requirements.
limits: Serialized-template inventory includes inactive objects and action-specific/entrance effects; counts are not simultaneous active particles. KR/CN versions differ.
